subject: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We discussed internally and want to propose consolidating three separate SKUs on the Order Form (Compute-Standard, Compute-HighMem, Compute-Burst) into a single Exhibit B with tiered pricing. The goals are: reduce administrative overhead, simplify invoicing, and leave routing rules unchanged.

Key asks from Atlas:
- Can Redwood accept a single consolidated Exhibit B that maps tiers back to the existing SKU behavior?
- We need a clear sequencing plan so our procurement team can sign the Order Form first and work with legal on the MSA exhibits after.
- Any material change to minimum commitments will need a short internal approval cycle — 7 business days.

Attaching a strawman Exhibit for your review. Happy to take a quick call if that helps.

Regards,
Sophie Turner
Head of Procurement, AtlasHealth
(sophie.turner@atlashealth.com)

Attachment: Exhibit-B_Atlas_Consolidation_v1.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@atlashealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Hi Sophie — appreciate the clarity and the strawman. Short answers first: yes, we can consolidate SKUs into a single Exhibit B with tier mappings, and we can sequence signature such that the Order Form is signed before exhibit finalization as long as the exhibit language includes transitional terms that preserve current routing/behavior.

Next steps I propose:
1) Our legal (cc: Karthik) will provide redlines to your Exhibit to ensure it ties to the MSA terms and preserves existing service commitments.
2) We will propose a sequencing clause to allow Order Form execution with a 30-day window to finalize the exhibit, with explicit rollback/credit mechanics if adjustments are needed after exhibit sign-off.
3) I will share an internal checklist (ops & billing) to ensure invoices map correctly to the consolidated tiers.

Karthik — can you take the attached strawman and give redline guidance by COB Monday? Laura and Marcus will help with billing/ops impacts. Sophie — can you confirm Atlas procurement’s 7 business day approval window is firm?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Exhibit-B_Atlas_Consolidation_v1.docx (docx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Kimberly / Sophie,

Attached are redlines (redlines_karthik_20270814.docx) — highlights and rationale below: 
- Clause: sequencing of execution — added a 30-day Exhibit Finalization Period after Order Form signature; during that period, Exhibit is "provisional" and provides functional mapping back to prior SKUs. This protects both sides operationally.
- Commitments: preserved existing minimums by mapping prior SKU minimums into equivalent tiered thresholds. I flagged a practical reconciliation mechanism for month 1 and month 2 usage to handle over/under allocation.
- Billing: added explicit invoice mapping examples in Exhibit B appendix to avoid disputes.
- Liability/Service Credits: left unchanged but added a short grace period for migration-related incidents.

Open items:
1) Sophie — confirm whether Atlas requires a hard signature on the exhibit before the first invoice posts. If yes, we can add conditional language about deferred invoicing.
2) Kimberly/Marcus — confirm billing system can accept consolidated SKU codes mapped to multiple internal GL lines (Marcus to advise).

I will also provide a tracked-change PDF if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_karthik_20270814.docx (docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sophie.turner@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Looping in billing & ops notes: 
- We can support consolidated tier codes, but it will require a one-time mapping table from Atlas (3 old SKUs -> 1 consolidated code). Marcus will handle the GL mapping; estimated work: 3 business days.
- Invoice samples: we'll produce two draft invoice formats (pre- and post-consolidation) for Atlas to validate.
- Suggestion: add a 14-day dispute window tied to the first two invoices post-migration to catch mapping issues quickly.

Kimberly — I can draft the ops checklist and attach it to the Order Form as an implementation exhibit. Marcus — can you confirm the 3 business day estimate?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sophie.turner@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Confirmed — 3 business days for the mapping and a one-time configuration fee (if Atlas requests a custom GL mapping beyond standard options). I'll include the configuration fee as an optional line in the Order Form and clearly mark it as bill-once.

Also attaching a short sample of the mapping table in CSV format in the internal doc.

Marcus Lin
Manager, Billing Systems

Attachment: OrderForm_Atlas_2027-08.pdf (pdf)

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA — multi-SKU consolidation and sequencing for order form

Thanks all — this is helpful and aligns with procurement expectations. Atlas confirms: 7 business-day review window for the Order Form; Exhibit may be finalized within 30 days after Order Form signature. Procurement will not require the exhibit signature prior to the first invoice posting, provided the provisional Exhibit language is included and Atlas receives the invoice mapping examples.

We are comfortable proceeding with the provisional sequencing language and the reconciliation mechanics you proposed. We will review Karthik’s redlines and respond by COB Wednesday.

Best,
Sophie
